teaser: You plug the platform into the outside world: an MCP client inside, servers outside, three primitives, three transports, mcp__server__tool names.
takeaways: The AI app hosts the MCP client; each integration is an MCP server exposing tools (actions), resources (data) and prompts (templates).
Client and server speak JSON-RPC over stdio (local subprocess), http (remote streamable) or sse (legacy): tools/list, then tools/call.
MCP tool names follow mcp__<server>__<tool>; allow them per tool or with a per-server wildcard like mcp__fs__* in allowed_tools.
create_sdk_mcp_server builds an in-process server from @tool functions: no network or subprocess, same security boundary as your app.
